# Plane Crash Example

```{r tidy_tc_crashes}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

crash_page |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1) > font > a") |> 
  rvest::html_text2() -> fatalities

df = data.frame(dates = dates, loc = loc_op[-1], fatalities = fatalities[-1]) |> 
  tidyr::separate(
    loc, into = c("location", "operator"), sep = "\n"
  )
  tidyr::seperate(fatalities, into)

# If I read this as an HTML tavle, I would have no control on what goes into each column in the resulting df, makes cleaning it (extracting exy from it) more challenging
```
